name: Spots
author: HamDash
description: Who is on the air now: POTA, SOTA, the cluster, RBN, and what contest is running

max_age_min.label: Hide spots older than (minutes)
max_age_min.help: A spot is somebody who was there a moment ago. An hour is the most this card will show whatever you put here.

bands.label: Bands
bands.help: Comma separated, e.g. '20m, 40m'. Empty shows every band. The tile's own filter bar does the same thing without saving it.

modes.label: Modes
modes.help: Comma separated, e.g. 'CW, SSB'. Empty shows every mode. Cluster spots carry no mode at all and are kept whatever this says.

tune_on_click.label: Clicking a frequency tunes the radio
tune_on_click.help: Off makes the frequency ordinary text, for a station where the radio is being driven by something else.

show_rbn.label: Reverse Beacon Network
show_rbn.help: A live telnet feed of what the skimmers are hearing. It logs in with your station callsign. Busy - five spots a second on CW - so use Watch below to narrow it.

rbn_feed.label: RBN feed
rbn_feed.help: 'cw' is the CW and RTTY skimmers, 'ft8' is FT8 and FT4. They are separate connections at the far end.

watch.label: Watch one callsign
watch.help: Applies to the live feeds. 'ME' means your own callsign, which on RBN is every skimmer that can hear you right now - the thing nothing else here answers. Empty shows everything, which is a lot.

show_cluster.label: DX cluster (telnet)
show_cluster.help: A DXSpider or CC-Cluster node. Logs in with your station callsign.

cluster_commands.label: Commands to send after login
cluster_commands.help: One per line, or separated by semicolons. Every cluster has its own - VE7CC prints them when you connect, e.g. 'set/ft8' or 'set/skimmer'.
